entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Vikash Chouksey, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Vishal Dhagat, learned Government Advocate for the  respondent/State.
Heard on IA No.9273/2018, an application for hearing sh the case during summer vacation.
ad Record of the Courts below be called for.
Pr Also heard on I.A. No.9272/2018, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of a petitoner-Prakash.

hy The petitioner has been convicted for commission of offence ad punishable under Section 16 r/w 7 (i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and awarded RI six months alongwith fine M amount of Rs.1000/-.

of Looking to the facts of the case and nature of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the matter, the IA is rt allowed and subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not ou deposited, remaining jail sentence of the petitioner is hereby suspended.

C It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of h Rs.50,000/- along with one solvent surety of like amount to the ig satisfaction of trial Court, the petitioner Prakash be released on H bail with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 18.12.2018 and on such other dates as are fixed by the office in this regard till disposal of this petition.
